descriptionHtml:
Candidate N24 · proposed P1 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

Text after the first 1,200 characters is ignored for tasks: follow-ups at the end of a long Hospital pre-round never become tasks, and a result dictated late in a long Nursing Home visit never closes its task (no message)

Tickets: TFA-92588 AC 10, TFA-92592 AC 2 · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Note: extractTasks receives substring(0, 1200). Also seen in TC-10/S28.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-22/S10

Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S09 Counts and length: open-task count 0 / 1 / 12, and a Hospital pre-round whose tasks come after character 1,200

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Tasks dictated in pre-round ('follow up BMP', 'PT eval', 'recheck weight in two weeks') appear on the patient's task list as three open tasks, one each (the precondition the Expected Result's 'the th … (UAT TC-22 step 1; TFA-92588 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). … (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U3 No duplicates: closing a task adds no new task for the same item, and Save & Extract never adds a task that is already on the list, open or closed (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U4 The task whose result is not dictated ('recheck weight in two weeks') stays open (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given C0: no open tasks; C1: 'Follow up BMP' only; C12: twelve open tasks; L1: a Hospital patient with no tasks and a 1,213-character pre-round narrative followed by the three UAT tasks

When C rows: Save & Extract with 'BMP came back, creatinine 1.1. PT saw her, walking with a walker.' in both contexts. L1: the Hospital pre-round harvest with the client's own 1,200-character cut

Then C0: nothing added. C1: BMP closes, nothing added. C12: BMP and PT close, the other ten stay open, nothing added or duplicated. L1: the three tasks appear, one each

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U2/U4 per row; U3 for C12 (each pattern matches exactly one task). L1: U1 sets no length limit; the runner sends the first 1,200 characters exactly as usePreRoundProcess.ts does, so on main L1 is expected to Fail (a finding against U1). Nursing Home pre-round makes no tasks on main (Q3), so L1 is Hospital only. C1/C12 carry the UAT known gap on the BMP closure (Q7)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

Local stack on main 43c38a4f; every model call the page makes is answered in the page by ext-support.ts (an ai/* call it is not told about is failed, never forwarded) and the tripwire showed no model call. The task extractor is a rule-based stand-in that can only find what the app sends it (args.content / args.openTasks), so the app's own request, cut, merge and storage are what is judged, not the model. Spec ext-tc22-s09-s10-length.spec.ts. C0/C1/C12 in both contexts (16/16 judged per context): every open task is sent (0, 1, 12), the answered ones close, the other ten stay open, nothing added or duplicated, the header counts the open tasks. L1 fails, 1/3 (deterministic): a 1,266-character pre-round note whose three tasks start at character 1,214 — the harvest request carries only the first 1,200 characters (usePreRoundProcess.ts: input.trim().substring(0, 1200)), so no extractor can see the tasks; after Save Note the list shows 0 pending tasks. The model half of C0/C1/C12 is the dev entry.

Product issue: Hospital: in a pre-round note longer than 1,200 characters, follow-ups dictated at the end ('Follow up BMP. PT eval. Recheck weight in two weeks.') never become tasks — the app sends only the first 1,200 characters to the task harvest; nothing tells the physician.

Evidence: 6 attached.

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [dev] failed (units/T22-S09.verdict.json) — s09-c1-h.md: "task: Follow up BMP" occurs 2 times, expected exactly 1 (in from "pending task") s09-c1-h.md: Known: no match for /\b0 pending tasks?\b/i (in from "pending task") — known: UAT TC-22 known gap: phrasing sensitivity, 'BMP came back' closed 3/10 in Run 7 (Q7) s09-c1-h.md: Known: "Reopen task: Follow up BMP" occurs 0 times, expected exactly 1 (in from "pending task") — known: UAT TC-22 …
  • [dev newspec-c] known gap (newspec-c/results.json) — newspec-c: failed → known gap (known gap) Dev agent unit T22-S09 (19:29 JST, Haiku). Each "occurs 2 times, expected exactly 1" problem is an oracle artifact, not a duplicate task: on 43c38a4f every task row has two buttons, "Complete task: X" and "Delete task: X", and the case counts "task: X" (snapshot lines 35/41, 43/49, 51/57); the count checks need anchoring to one of them (matrix fix pending…
